bool valid(int r, int c) {
    return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < n && board1[r][c] >= '0' && board1[r][c] <= '9';
}

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, rev;
    Edge(int t, int c, int r) : to(t), cap(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<Edge> adj[MAX_N * 2];
int lvl[MAX_N * 2], ptr[MAX_N * 2];

void connect(int u, int v, int c) {
    adj[u].emplace_back(v, c, adj[v].size());
    adj[v].emplace_back(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1);
}

void expand(int r, int c) {
    if (board2[r][c]) {
        connect(node_id[r][c] + node_cnt, 2 * node_cnt + 1, board2[r][c] - '0');
    }
    if (board1[r][c] == '0') return;
    
    connect(0, node_id[r][c], board1[r][c] - '0');
    if (board2[r][c]) {
        connect(node_id[r][c], node_id[r][c] + node_cnt, 10);
    }

    int sr = r, sc = c;
    queue<int> q1r, q1c, q2r, q2c;
    q1r.push(r); q1c.push(c);
    q2r.push(zero_r); q2c.push(zero_c);

    vector<vector<int>> d1(n, vector<int>(n, -1));
    vector<vector<int>> d2(n, vector<int>(n, -1));
    d1[r][c] = 0;
    d2[zero_r][zero_c] = 0;

    while (!q1r.empty()) {
        int sz = q1r.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
            int ur = q1r.front(); q1r.pop();
            int uc = q1c.front(); q1c.pop();
            if (d2[ur][uc] >= 0) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = ur + dr[k], nc = uc + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && d1[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    d1[nr][nc] = d1[ur][uc] + 1;
                    if (d1[nr][nc] > T) break;
                    if (d2[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                    q1r.push(nr); q1c.push(nc);
                    if (board2[nr][nc] != '0') {
                        connect(node_id[sr][sc], node_id[nr][nc] + node_cnt, 10);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        sz = q2r.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
            int ur = q2r.front(); q2r.pop();
            int uc = q2c.front(); q2c.pop();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = ur + dr[k], nc = uc + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && d2[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    d2[nr][nc] = d2[ur][uc] + 1;
                    q2r.push(nr); q2c.push(nc);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool bfs_level() {
    memset(lvl, -1, sizeof(lvl));
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(0);
    lvl[0] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const auto& e : adj[u]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] == -1) {
                lvl[e.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
    return lvl[2 * node_cnt + 1] != -1;
}

int dfs_flow(int u, int flow) {
    if (u == 2 * node_cnt + 1) return flow;
    for (int& i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = adj[u][i];
        if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] == lvl[u] + 1) {
            int pushed = dfs_flow(e.to, min(flow, e.cap));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.cap -= pushed;
                adj[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic_max_flow() {
    int total = 0;
    while (bfs_level()) {
        memset(ptr, 0, sizeof(ptr));
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs_flow(0, INT_MAX)) > 0) {
            total += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> T;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> board1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> board2[i];

    memset(node_id, -1, sizeof(node_id));
    node_cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (board1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                zero_r = i; zero_c = j;
            } else if (valid(i, j)) {
                node_id[i][j] = ++node_cnt;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (valid(i, j)) {
                expand(i, j);
            }
        }
    }

    cout << dinic_max_flow() << '\n';
    return 0;
}
